title: ADP National Employment Report (Jan 2027 data), 08:15 ET
source: EST: derived from the two cadence rules this calendar's own ADP entries already document and validate against each other — the report publishes on the first Wednesday of the month, and two sessions before the BLS Employment Situation Friday it previews. Both rules agree on 2027-02-03: the first Wednesday of February 2027 is the 3rd (February 2027 opens on a Monday), and jobs-2027-02-05 is the tracked Friday payrolls print, itself derived from BLS's own third-Friday-after-the-reference-week rule and re-validated 7 for 7 by that event's initial research. The dual-rule agreement is the same standard adp-employment-2026-12-02 was filed on, and the pairing holds on all four tracked 2026 editions (2026-09-02 with jobs 2026-09-04; 2026-09-30 with 2026-10-02; 2026-11-04 with 2026-11-06; 2026-12-02 with 2026-12-04). Filed estimate on three counts: no FRED forward calendar entry for 2027 could be read (fred.stlouisfed.org/releases/calendar?rid=194 returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-10 but its year view carries no 2027 dates), ADP has not itself named the date — its naming arrives in the body of a prior release, the promotion path the 2026 entries verified — and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Discovered 2026-09-10 during the never-assessed initial research of treasury-borrowing-estimates-2027-02-01, where it is the first untracked dated item in that event's +/-5 day corridor
notes: PROPOSED, not canonical — the first 2027 ADP edition on this calendar, which currently stops at 2026-12-02 and so has no continuous private-payrolls series through the February-2027 refunding week. Its relevance to the proposer is CORRIDOR DENSITY, not price. 2027-02-03 already carries treasury-refunding-2027-02-03 at 08:30 ET (medium) and ism-services-2027-02-03 at 10:00 ET (high); adding an 08:15 ET private-payrolls print makes the refunding statement the SECOND release of its own morning, fifteen minutes after a labour read, two days after a session that already stacks BoJ, ISM Manufacturing, SLOOS and the borrowing estimates, and two days before the annual-benchmark payrolls print on 2027-02-05. That is the attribution problem the proposer's ledger is built around, extended across the whole week: no move anywhere in 2027-02-01 -> 2027-02-05 is attributable to any single release. Impact MEDIUM, carried unchanged from the four tracked 2026 editions rather than re-measured here — a drive-by adjacency inherits its sibling's tier and earns its own only from its own initial research. Estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
